title: Cyber-Physical Systems Security & Semantics
summary: We recover system semantics from legacy and modern cyber-physical systems, then use that structure to test, harden, and explain behavior in physical testbeds.

title: Digital Twins & Formal Verification
summary: We build fidelity-aware twins that connect hybrid models, runtime traces, and verification workflows for safer design decisions.

title: IoT & Sensor Privacy
summary: Privacy-preserving sensing and information flow for trustworthy ubiquitous systems, from edge to cloud.

title: Brain-Centered CPS / NeuroIoT
summary: We study human-in-the-loop CPS that combines neural and environmental sensing with multimodal, memory-centered modeling.

title: Digital Twinning for Industrial Control Systems
summary: We build industrial-control twins that connect control code, process models, and testbeds for validation, conformance checking, and mitigation synthesis.
